guide: ReminderPicker(title, options?, remindBefore?, repeatDays?) — a reminder card: when (quick chips + pick a date), how many minutes before (0-120), repeat every N days. title is what to remind about; options = [{label, at}] with at a local ISO datetime ("2026-11-16T18:00"), first is preselected; defaults to today 6 pm / tomorrow 9 am. Use it when the user asks to be reminded. Events: set_reminder {title, at, remindBefore, repeatDays}, add_to_calendar {same}, dismiss_reminder {}. Example: card = ReminderPicker("Review the report", [{label: "Today 6 pm", at: "2026-11-16T18:00"}, {label: "Tomorrow 9 am", at: "2026-11-17T09:00"}], 45, 2)

ReminderPicker.description: A reminder picker with time chips, a lead-time slider and a repeat stepper.

title.description: What to remind about, e.g. "Review the report".

options.description: Quick time choices; the first is selected. Defaults to today 6 pm and tomorrow 9 am.

remindBefore.description: Minutes before the time to remind (0-120). Default 0.

repeatDays.description: Repeat every N days; 0 = never. Default 0.
